paper_title: Limits on Axion Couplings from the first 80-day data of PandaX-II Experiment
notes: PandaX-II constrains the axion-electron coupling g_Ae. Reported here is the solar-axion (CBRD) flat limit g_Ae <= 4.35e-12 for m_a from 1e-5 to 1 keV/c^2 (=1e-2 to 1e3 eV), stated as similar to LUX. NOTE: the paper is internally inconsistent about the number: abstract says 4.35e-12, main text says 4e-13, and the summary says 4.35e-11 (4.35e-12 chosen as consistent with 'similar to LUX' ~3.5e-12). Additional results not encoded here: (1) a 57Fe 14.4 keV monoenergetic solar-axion line reaching g_Ae ~6e-14 at m_a=10 keV; (2) galactic ALP (dark matter, rho=0.3 GeV/cm^3) limit ~few×10^-13 (text: <=4e-13; summary: <4.3e-14) over m_a=1-25 keV, which is mass-dependent (Fig.4). The galactic part is the DM-search component justifying the 0.3 GeV/cm^3 density.
